description: Paclitaxel is indicated for the initial treatment of locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer in combination with trastuzumab, in patients who over-express HER-2 (human epidermal growth factor receptor 2) at a 3+ level as determined by immunohistochemistry and for whom an anthracycline is not suitable.
